glosses: Donner un caractère politique à quelque chose.

examples.text: Moscou essaie de politiser l'aide humanitaire au tiers-monde.

glosses: Donner une conscience politique à quelqu'un.
To engage in or discuss politics.
To give something political characteristics; to turn into a political issue.

examples.text: My parents started politicizing the weather as soon as they opened their snowplow business.

glosses: To make someone politically active or aware.

examples.text: The possibility of setting up an educational arm which could politicize gays in Massachusetts through a series of seminars and through the publication of a booklet providing a background on the history of gay rights.
